title: Stable Project Memory

project_identification.full_title: Design and Development of a Progressive Web App Integrated Catering Management System for Dos Hermanos with Online Reservation, Package Customization, Inventory and Payment Tracking, Event Equipment Accountability, and Report Generation
project_identification.stage: Demonstration & Test Version Development (Phase 1 Complete, Stage 1 Initialization)

core_business_purpose: Replace scattered paper notebooks, verbal checking, and mobile-phone records with a unified, web-based Progressive Web App (PWA) connecting reservations, date availability, event scheduling, package customization, inventory tracking, deposit/payment tracking, equipment release/returns, report generation, and audit trails.

technology_stack.application_model: Single Progressive Web App (PWA) accessible via desktop browsers and installable on mobile devices

undefined_by_source_elements: Exact Firebase database engine (Firestore vs Realtime DB)
Exact customer contact fields and registration details
Specific package names, menu item catalog, and base price figures
Exact mathematical formulas for guest-to-food, guest-to-service, and guest-to-supply calculations
Exact stock thresholds, ingredient measurement units, and initial stock quantities
Exact inventory behavior upon order cancellation
Specific visual layout, UI branding, color scheme, and typography guidelines
